content.body: Hi Bob! Following up on Eve's message in #general about the great restaurant near the office (Zurich Restaurant, www.restaurant-zurich.com): it serves authentic Swiss cuisine — traditional Swiss dishes like savory cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. It's a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city with rustic wooden interiors and panoramic city-skyline views.
